G241131.description: Victoria is the capital and largest city of Seychelles, situated on the north-eastern side of Mahé, the archipelago's main island. The city was first established as the seat of the British colonial government.

G241423.description: Bel Ombre (French pronunciation: [bɛl ɔ̃bʁ], or Belombre) is an administrative district of Seychelles located on the island of Mahé. It has a small fishing harbour for artesan fishing from small boats with lines.

G241427.description: Beau Vallon (French pronunciation: [bo valɔ̃] ) is a bay on the north western coast of Mahé in the Seychelles. Beau Vallon Beach is well-frequented and is possibly the most popular beach on the island.

G241443.description: Anse Royale (French pronunciation: [ɑ̃s ʁwajal]) is an administrative district of Seychelles located on the island of Mahé. The Seychelles Polytechnic School of the Humanities is located in this district.

G241448.description: Anse Boileau (French pronunciation: [ɑ̃s bwalo] ) is an administrative district on the south of the island of Mahé in the Seychelles. Anse Boileau encapsulates the natural wonders of the Seychelles: it sits at the foot of a steep, green mountain, it is on the shores of the Indian Ocean, and in its midst are streams, mini-forests, creeks, ponds, and an enchanting array of all that defines the Seychellois landscape.
